_meta.purpose: R10 ratchet baseline. The set of LIVE pages that render a transliteration with no named transliterationSource, frozen at the moment R10 was written. R10 fails only if a page appears OUTSIDE this list — the debt cannot grow, and it is printed every run so it cannot go quiet.
_meta.why: These pages shipped before R10 existed. Their romanisation traces to github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json — one file, one commit, no README, no licence, no stated scheme, stored in a field called LANGUAGE_ARABIC_TRANSLATED_TEXT. There is no attributable source to name, so this is not fixable by metadata. See doc/DUA-PARKED-REVIEWER-QUESTIONS.md item 8.
_meta.doNotAdd: Never add an id here to make a build pass. This file records what already shipped; a NEW unsourced transliteration is exactly the failure R10 exists to catch.
_meta.shrinkIsGood: Removing ids as they gain a real source, or as the transliteration stops rendering, is the intended direction. R10 never fails for the list getting shorter.
